```{r}
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

Loading agriculture dataset
```{r}
agri_data <- read.csv(
  "data/agriculture.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)
agri_data
```

Exploring agriculture dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

crop_data <- agri_data %>%
  filter(
    Area %in% c("Pakistan", "India"),
    Item %in% c("Wheat", "Rice", "Maize (corn)"),
    Element %in% c("Area harvested", "Yield", "Production"),
    !is.na(Value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Item = recode(Item, "Maize (corn)" = "Maize")
  ) %>%
  select(Area, Item, Year, Element, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Element,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  rename(
    country = Area,
    crop = Item,
    year = Year,
    area_ha = `Area harvested`,
    yield_kg_ha = Yield,
    production_t = Production
  ) %>%
  arrange(country, crop, year)
```
